the renderer ignores shape-name tags: cameltoe never rendered (0 attempts); tape constructs mostly die
an underlayer (bra/camisole/bandeau) under a sheer garment renders the UNDERLAYER — the tier drops to R

signal tags at the TAIL of the tag-run render weak — claims sit in the first ~12 tags
opaque structured fabrics (jeans/denim/leather/velvet/sweatpants/breeches/suit) never carry an edge
